settings_capture_clash_dock: {action} uses {key}, which the agent dock already uses. Pick another key for one of them.
settings_capture_clash_same_key: {first} and {second} use the same key ({key}). Give one of them another.
settings_capture_clicks_description: A ring on each click in screen recordings and GIFs.
settings_capture_copy_description: Put every capture on the clipboard as soon as it is taken: screenshots as an image, recordings and GIFs as the file.
settings_capture_corner_description: The corner of the display under the pointer where the quick access cards stack.
settings_capture_dismiss_description: Seconds before the card goes away by itself, 0 to 60. 0 keeps it until you close it.
settings_capture_enabled_description: Turn the capture hotkeys on or off. Off gives the keys back to other apps.
settings_capture_group_capture_descripti: Take screenshots and record the screen from a hotkey, from any app. Files go to the folder below.
settings_capture_group_history_descripti: Your recent captures. Removing one only forgets it here: the file is never deleted from your disk.
settings_capture_group_hotkeys_descripti: Click a key, then press the new one. {@common_keys_escape} cancels. A key must include {modifiers} so it does not take that key from every app.
settings_capture_hide_icons_description: Hide the icons on the desktop while a screenshot or recording is taken.
settings_capture_highlight_description: Show the pointer and a ring on each click in screen recordings and GIFs.
settings_capture_history_size_descriptio: How many captures to remember, 1 to 500. Older ones drop off the list; their files stay.
settings_capture_key_all_in_one_descript: One toolbar over the screen: pick region, window, screen, record, GIF or text.
settings_capture_key_fullscreen_descript: Capture the whole screen under the pointer.
settings_capture_key_gif_description: Pick an area and record an animated GIF.
settings_capture_key_ocr_description: Drag over text on screen and copy it, read on this Mac.
settings_capture_key_previous_descriptio: Capture the same area as your last region capture, right now.
settings_capture_key_record_description: Pick an area and record a video. Press the key again to stop.
settings_capture_key_region_description: Drag to pick an area, or press {@common_keys_space} to switch to picking a window.
settings_capture_key_window_description: Click a window to capture it.
settings_capture_keystrokes_description: A pill with the keys you press at the bottom of the recorded area. macOS asks for Input Monitoring the first time.
settings_capture_microphone_description: Your voice goes into the video. macOS asks for microphone access the first time. Not in GIFs.
settings_capture_on_release_description: Take the shot as soon as you let go of the selection; turn off to adjust it first and confirm with {@common_os_enter_key}.
settings_capture_on_release_label: Capture when the mouse is released
settings_capture_permission_description: Screen Recording lets Atlas see the pixels of other apps. It is only used when you press a capture hotkey; nothing is recorded in the background. After granting it, macOS asks you to restart Atlas.
settings_capture_preset_apply_blocked: Turn off macOS's own screenshot shortcuts first (below)
settings_capture_preset_cleanshot_note: These are macOS's own screenshot keys ({screen}, {area}, {toolbar}, {touchBar}), and macOS answers them before any app. Atlas never changes a system setting for you: open System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > Screenshots, untick them, then tick "{@settings_capture_system_keys_off_label}" here. Until then this preset stays unavailable.
settings_capture_preset_ctrl_shift_note: {example} is not a macOS key, but a few terminals and editors use {modifiers} digits; if one stops responding, pick another preset.
settings_capture_preset_description: Start from a ready-made set of keys. Picking one shows what it changes; nothing is saved until you apply it.
settings_capture_preset_shift_cmd_s_note: {key} is "Save As" in most apps. As a global hotkey it wins over the app in front, so Save As stops working everywhere while Atlas runs. macOS keeps {screen}, {area} and {toolbar} for itself, which is why they are not offered here.
settings_capture_quality_description: Lower qualities record fewer pixels, so the file is smaller. GIFs are not affected.
settings_capture_quick_access_descriptio: A small card with the capture: copy, save as, annotate, send to an agent, or drag it into another app.
settings_capture_recent_description: Open, reveal or remove from the list your recent captures. Removing never deletes the file.
settings_capture_recent_forget: Forget this capture. The file stays on your disk.
settings_capture_scale_description: Retina saves the display's own pixels; Standard saves one pixel per point, a smaller file.
settings_capture_sound_description: A shutter sound when a screenshot is taken.
settings_capture_stack_description: How many quick access cards stack in the corner before the oldest goes, 1 to 8.
settings_capture_system_audio_descriptio: The sound your Mac plays goes into the video. Not in GIFs.
settings_capture_system_keys_accepted: Atlas now accepts {range}. If you turn the macOS ones back on, these keys stop working here.

match.countPlural=one: {keys} still belongs to macOS. Turn it off in System Settings, tick the box above, or pick another key.
match.countPlural=*: {keys} still belong to macOS. Turn them off in System Settings, tick the box above, or pick other keys.

settings_capture_system_keys_description: macOS answers {screen}, {area}, {toolbar} and {touchBar} before any app, so Atlas can only use them once you turn them off yourself in System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > Screenshots. Atlas never changes that setting for you.
settings_capture_system_keys_off_aria: I turned the macOS screenshot shortcuts off
settings_capture_timer_description: Wait this long after you pick before a screenshot is taken. Recordings are not delayed.
settings_capture_window_background_descr: A window capture sits on a padded background instead of a shadow. It wins over the shadow when both are on.
settings_capture_window_shadow_descripti: A window capture keeps its drop shadow, on a transparent background.
